title: Improve app-shell landmarks and add a skip link (WCAG 2.4.1)
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Streamlit’s app shell should expose clear page landmarks and a way to skip repeated chrome, so keyboard and screen-reader users can move straight to the main content (WCAG 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks).

Today the shell has a semantic `<header>` and a labeled sidebar region, but the primary content area (`stMain`) is a `<section>` rather than `<main>`, sidebar/page navigation is not exposed as a `navigation` landmark, and there is no skip link.

### Why?

Without a main landmark and a skip mechanism, assistive-tech users often have to tab through header, toolbar, and sidebar controls on every page load or navigation. This was called out as part of the “page structure” ask in #8399 (now closed/triaged). Our theme a11y inventory also leaves WCAG **2.4.1** unscored.

### How?

Suggested shell improvements (exact shape TBD):

1. **Main landmark** — Render the primary app content as `<main>` (or give `stMain` an equivalent landmark role), without breaking existing layout/scroll behavior or `data-testid="stMain"` consumers.
2. **Navigation landmark** — Expose sidebar page nav and/or top nav as `<nav>` (or `role="navigation"`) with an accessible name when present.
3. **Skip link** — Add a keyboard-focusable “Skip to main content” link (visually hidden until focused) that moves focus into the main landmark.

Out of scope for this issue: author-controlled heading hierarchy inside app content; document language (`lang`) which is tracked in #15726; focus-indicator bugs on `stMain` which are tracked separately in #17338.

### Additional Context

- Spun out from the #8399 triage (page structure / landmarks / skip links).
- Related open focus/keyboard shell issues (not duplicates): #17338, #17339.
- Wiki: `wiki/accessibility-theme.md` notes 2.4.1 as not evaluated; `wiki/accessibility-wcag.md` likewise leaves shell 2.4.1 unscored.
- Current rough DOM shape:
  - Header: semantic `<header>`
  - Sidebar: labeled region (`aria-label="Sidebar"`)
  - Main scroll region: `<section class="stMain" data-testid="stMain" tabindex="0">` (not `<main>`)
  - No skip link in the app shell
